
---
title: "Bayesian Decision Trees"
---

# Introduction

A Bayesian decision tree defines a posterior
distribution over possible decision-tree structures.

Instead of selecting a single optimal tree, we
consider multiple trees weighted by their posterior
probabilities.

## Bayesian Posterior

$$
p(T \mid D) =
\frac{p(D \mid T)p(T)}{p(D)}
$$

## Why use Bayesian decision trees?

- Account for uncertainty in tree structure.
- Average predictions across multiple trees.
- Incorporate prior preferences for simpler trees.
